Demonstration data is synthetic. This console illustrates privacy by design; production deployment requires a threat model, key lifecycle management, model monitoring, and site-specific governance.

Privacy controls

Sentinel only processes the fields needed for the safety decision. The gateway pseudonymises the device identifier, reduces location to an approved zone, encrypts telemetry in transit, and applies a 24-hour default retention policy.
